title: Baby Cate shares a new track "SLEEP"
htmlContent:
Talented-artist, singer and songwriter Baby Cate returned with a new single called "SLEEP". The song "SLEEP" is a special piece of audio that serves it purpose. It’s a record that goes beyond just good sounds to hear, but a masterpiece that connects to the listener on a body and soul level. She delivers in every way on what is a master class performance to stand out in every way on this must hear song.

Baby Cate brings a fresh approach that makes you listen and take in the music, as you get swept up in the appeal of the music. She shines vocally with a tone that was meant to travel the world, over this production that is a match made in heaven with her singing, to make it a record you can’t get enough of.
